batch113-F001
Snapshot: RU candidate 9c0d08e89b144681713397b613a5f7bda7f47619; original candidate 66316abd112bc5621fb36ccc5ad2536dc3b79d09; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f. Closing gate passed.
Scope: All prescribed guidance windows (4 files), all 3 rubrics, three complete kanji/成.md versions, KanjiPedia entry, KANJIDIC2 成 and JMdict 1375610/1375690, all 394 typed-title rows, exact amendment and continuity record read completely; every helper returned exit 0. No window failed.
C1 CLEAN: «становиться» preserves become; «добиваться результата» aptly conveys 成す/なしとげる accomplishment and the source’s reaching-a-result sense. Bound sources support becoming, attaining/accomplishing, and growth; no need to change the title.
C2 CLEAN (bounded scope): Diff changes only title and H1; continuity confirms the sole runtime identity change is kanji/成.md and the 394-row pool differs only at 成’s title. Eight NAV patches and other metadata are unchanged. Retain all 12 original S-intro-only dispositions, including N001–N004; none is upgraded. Active-negative runtime status remains U.
C3 CLEAN: The paired infinitives «становиться; добиваться результата» are natural, clear Russian and fit the unchanged explanation of becoming and completion/success as results.
F001 RESOLVED: The misleading «совершаться» is replaced in both learner-facing title locations by an accomplishment gloss supported by the bound text.
Wording decision: «Добиваться результата» is a sound adaptation of the proposed «достигать результата»: both convey accomplishment, while the former avoids repeating the exact «достигать» wording in 達 and 到. That rationale is real. Their concepts remain nearby, but the explicit object «результата» and distinction between accomplishing an outcome and reaching/arriving do not create a confirmed confusing typed-title collision. 成’s new title also has no collision with 戦, 代, or 試.
Continuity: N001–N004 remain introductory/source-core comparisons only; all 12 original directions retain S-intro (runtime active-negative U), with no qualification upgrade. All 8 NAV patches and remaining metadata are unchanged.
Findings: none additional
Optional: 達 «достигать; суффикс множественности» and 到 «прибывать; достигать» are the nearest wording/concept neighbors; the chosen wording distinguishes them adequately in this pool.
Limits: No tests, validators, builds, or web pages used, as instructed. This is a bounded wording/scope review, not approval of ordinary runtime distractor safety, broader fallback behavior, frequency, or global title uniqueness.
